verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents OAuth client-credentials issuance for server-to-server use, with one-time-shown secrets and rotation. Write capabilities (create/update/delete) are withheld until Harbor explicitly grants them to the account, so credentials default to read-only access. That restriction is set by the vendor at account level, not by the user per credential, so least-privilege scoping by the user is not shown. missing for 10: user-selectable per-credential scopes or permissions, multiple distinct credentials with different privilege levels for different agents, documented scope parameters in the token exchange, independent or hands-on corroboration.
